content.text: {"summary":"Weatherbot's level for Parliament Square rose to level 4, Warning / Watch / Evacuation, up from level 3, Watch / Hurricane Threat. A Tropical Storm Warning for Demo now covers the location, replacing the earlier Tropical Storm Watch [S1]. This follows advisory 8, issued 2026-10-12 at 21:00 UTC, which moved past advisory 6 [S1].","sources":["S1"]}
